event.title: I Love Free Software Day at Warsaw Hackerspace in Warsaw, Poland

body.p: In Warsaw Hackerspace, we are celebrating the ‘I Love Free Software Day’ with Free Software Foundation Europe's (FSFE) and Warsaw Hackerspace.

ul.li: 📅 The celebrations will be on the 13th of February 2026, 18:00 (CET)
📍 Warsaw Hackerspace, Hackerspace address: Żelazna 103A, 01-017 Warsaw.
Programm: Agenda and more information coming soon.
